meanings.note: Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (stem 'сыпаться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'wake up', paired with 'проснуться'.
